7666.title: System prompt reconstruction retains SDK snapshot defaults
7666.rootCauseOneLine: Both prompt modes retain the SDK's recorded-prompt default, which conflicts with applying fresh instructions at construction; verified at the option boundary in two trusted checkouts.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — addresses the verified SDK option mismatch
prReviews.topFinding: Both modes explicitly opt out of snapshots; no definite defect identified by static inspection. The PR branch and live behavior were not run.

7666.proposedFix: Disable recorded prompt reuse for preset and custom prompt construction; verify changed and unchanged cold resumes on a recording-enabled account. Existing open PR #7667 prevents a duplicate automatic fix.
7666.caveats: Only the SDK-option contract was reproduced. Live model answers, recording rollout, prompt-cache costs, and reasoning retention were not tested. The unchanged existing bridge suite has five failures.
